# Sport templates — table formats and rules

<!-- Generated by scripts/sport-guide.mjs from the sport catalogue. Edit the script, not this file. -->

A reference for **Add → From a sport template…** in the data panel ([User Guide §12, Sport templates](USER-GUIDE.md#sport-templates)). It lists every sport, the rule sets it offers, the clocks and scoring each rule set brings, and the columns of each table, with examples — what a Google Sheet or a JSON feed needs to carry to drive the same graphics.

Every rule set links to the governing body's own rules, which is where its period lengths, clocks and scoring come from. Rules change between seasons: if your competition plays to different numbers, change the clock on the layer and the period count in the game row — nothing in Breeze is locked to the preset.

**How to read the tables.** *Type* is what the column holds: `number`, `string` or `boolean` (`true` / `false`). A *required* column must be present for the source check to pass; the others can be left out or left blank. A closed list (`home`, `away`) means any other value is flagged. Columns the template does not know are fine — they are kept and can be bound like any other.

**Where the rows come from.** Typed into Breeze (five manual tables), one Google Sheet with a tab per table named `teams`, `players`, `coaches`, `venue` and `game`, or a CSV or JSON URL per table. A JSON feed returns an array of row objects — `[{ "side": "home", "name": "Phoenix", … }]` — with column names as keys.

**Columns the Game block works out.** Some game columns are calculated from others when the operator scores from the control panel: an AFL `12.9.81`, a GAA `1-12`, cricket overs and run rates, a tennis `40` or `AD`. They are marked *Worked out* below. A feed that drives the game row itself sends them too, already worked out.

## Tables every sport shares

Teams, players, coaches and venue have the same columns in every sport, plus a few statistics of the sport's own, listed under each sport below. Racket sports (tennis, badminton, table tennis, pickleball) treat a "team" as a player or a pair, so their teams table has `country` and `seed` instead of `record`, `rank` and `coach`, and `abbr` is optional.

### Teams

One row per side.

| Column | Type | Required | Example or allowed values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `side` | string | yes | `home`, `away` | Side |
| `name` | string | yes | `Phoenix` | Name |
| `shortName` | string |  | `PHX Suns` | Short name |
| `abbr` | string | yes | `PHX` | Abbreviation |
| `color` | string |  | `#e56020` | Colour |
| `color2` | string |  | `#1d1160` | Second colour |
| `logo` | string |  | `assets/logo-home.png` | Logo |
| `record` | string |  | `12-4` | Record |
| `rank` | number |  |  | Rank |
| `coach` | string |  |  | Coach |

Example:

```csv
side,name,shortName,abbr,color,color2,logo,record,rank,coach
home,Phoenix,PHX Suns,PHX,#e56020,#1d1160,assets/logo-home.png,12-4,,
```

### Players

One row per player. `team` matches the team's `abbr` (racket sports: `home` or `away`).

| Column | Type | Required | Example or allowed values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `team` | string | yes | `PHX` | Team |
| `number` | string | yes | `23` | Number |
| `name` | string | yes | `Jordan Smith` | Name |
| `firstName` | string |  | `Jordan` | First name |
| `lastName` | string |  | `Smith` | Last name |
| `position` | string |  | `G` | Position |
| `headshot` | string |  | `assets/smith.png` | Headshot |
| `starter` | boolean |  |  | Starter |
| `active` | boolean |  |  | On the field |

Example:

```csv
team,number,name,firstName,lastName,position,headshot,starter,active
PHX,23,Jordan Smith,Jordan,Smith,G,assets/smith.png,,
```

### Coaches

One row per coach. `team` matches the team's `abbr`.

| Column | Type | Required | Example or allowed values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `team` | string | yes | `PHX` | Team |
| `name` | string | yes | `Pat Lee` | Name |
| `role` | string | yes | `Head coach` | Role |
| `headshot` | string |  | `assets/lee.png` | Headshot |

Example:

```csv
team,name,role,headshot
PHX,Pat Lee,Head coach,assets/lee.png
```

### Venue

One row.

| Column | Type | Required | Example or allowed values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | `Footprint Center` | Venue |
| `city` | string |  | `Phoenix` | City |
| `region` | string |  | `AZ` | State / region |
| `capacity` | number |  | `17071` | Capacity |
| `attendance` | number |  | `16210` | Attendance |
| `surface` | string |  | `Hardwood` | Surface |
| `weather` | string |  | `Indoors` | Weather |
| `officials` | string |  | `J. Doe, A. Roe` | Officials |
| `broadcast` | string |  | `Channel 5` | Broadcast |
| `notes` | string |  |  | Notes |

Example:

```csv
name,city,region,capacity,attendance,surface,weather,officials,broadcast,notes
Footprint Center,Phoenix,AZ,17071,16210,Hardwood,Indoors,"J. Doe, A. Roe",Channel 5,
```

Racket sports' teams table:

```csv
side,name,shortName,abbr,color,color2,logo,country,seed
home,A. Player,Player,PLA,#e56020,#1d1160,assets/logo-home.png,USA,
```

### Game

One row: the live state of the game. Every sport's game table starts with these columns; the sport adds its own after them (listed under each sport).

| Column | Type | Required | Example or allowed values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | yes | `pre`, `live`, `final` | Status |
| `period` | number | yes | `2` | Period |
| `periodLabel` | string |  | `2nd` | Period label. Written by the period arrows; type your own to override. |
| `homeScore` | number | yes | `54` | Home score |
| `awayScore` | number | yes | `51` | Away score |
| `possession` | string |  | `home`, `away`, (blank) | Possession |
| `home1`, `home2`, `home3`, `home4`, `homeOT` | number | | | Home points in each quarter — the line score |
| `away1`, `away2`, `away3`, `away4`, `awayOT` | number | | | Away points in each quarter — the line score |

The line score has one column per period of the rule set — `home1`…`home4` for four quarters — plus `homeOT` for overtime, or `homeX` for extra innings. The racket sports keep a line score per set or game; soccer, both rugby codes, Gaelic games and cricket have none.

`periodLabel` is how a broadcast writes the period: `3rd`, `OT`, `2OT`, `SO`, `2nd Half`, `Top 7th`, `Set 3`, `Game 2`, `2nd innings`.

## Basketball

*US school & pro* · source ids start `bball-` (`bball-teams`, `bball-game`…)

### Rule sets

| Rule set | Periods | Clocks offered | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| NBA — 4 × 12:00, 24 s shot clock | 4 quarters | Game clock: 12:00 down<br>Shot clock: 24 s down | [NBA Official Rule Book](https://official.nba.com/rulebook) |
| WNBA — 4 × 10:00, 24 s shot clock | 4 quarters | Game clock: 10:00 down<br>Shot clock: 24 s down | [WNBA Rule Book](https://www.wnba.com/wnba-rule-book) |
| NCAA men — 2 × 20:00, 30 s shot clock | 2 halves | Game clock: 20:00 down<br>Shot clock: 30 s down | [NCAA men's basketball playing rules](https://www.ncaa.org/championships/playing-rules/mens-basketball-playing-rules/) |
| NCAA women — 4 × 10:00, 30 s shot clock | 4 quarters | Game clock: 10:00 down<br>Shot clock: 30 s down | [NCAA women's basketball playing rules](https://www.ncaa.org/championships/playing-rules/womens-basketball-playing-rules/) |
| High school (NFHS) — 4 × 8:00, 35 s shot clock where used | 4 quarters | Game clock: 8:00 down<br>Shot clock: 35 s down | [NFHS basketball (rules books are sold through NFHS)](https://nfhs.org/sports/basketball) |
| FIBA — 4 × 10:00, 24 s shot clock | 4 quarters | Game clock: 10:00 down<br>Shot clock: 24 s down | [FIBA Official Basketball Rules](https://refereeing.fiba.basketball/en/rules) |

- **High school (NFHS):** The shot clock is adopted state by state; leave the shot-clock layer off where your association does not use one.

### Scoring

Game block buttons, one set per side: **+1** · **+2** · **+3**. **−** takes one **+1** back.

### Teams and players

Statistics added to the [teams table](#teams): `fgPct` (number), `threePct` (number), `ftPct` (number), `rebounds` (number), `assists` (number), `turnovers` (number).

Statistics added to the [players table](#players): `pts` (number), `reb` (number), `ast` (number), `stl` (number), `blk` (number), `fouls` (number), `min` (number).

### Game table

The [shared game columns](#game) (`status`, `period`, `periodLabel`, `homeScore`, `awayScore`, `possession`), a line score, and the sport's own:

| Column | Type | Required | Example or allowed values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `home1`, `home2`, `home3`, `home4`, `homeOT` | number | | | Home points in each quarter — the line score |
| `away1`, `away2`, `away3`, `away4`, `awayOT` | number | | | Away points in each quarter — the line score |
| `homeFouls` | number |  |  | Home Fouls |
| `awayFouls` | number |  |  | Away Fouls |
| `homeTimeouts` | number |  |  | Home Timeouts |
| `awayTimeouts` | number |  |  | Away Timeouts |
| `homeBonus` | boolean |  |  | Home Bonus |
| `awayBonus` | boolean |  |  | Away Bonus |
| `arrow` | string |  | `home`, `away`, (blank) | Possession arrow |

The line score shown is for **NBA**; it has one column per period of the rule set you pick.

Example — a game in progress (NBA):

```csv
status,period,periodLabel,homeScore,awayScore,possession,home1,home2,home3,home4,homeOT,away1,away2,away3,away4,awayOT,homeFouls,awayFouls,homeTimeouts,awayTimeouts,homeBonus,awayBonus,arrow
live,3,3rd,72,68,home,24,22,26,,,20,25,23,,,4,6,3,2,false,true,away
```

The [shared game columns](#game) (`status`, `period`, `periodLabel`, `homeScore`, `awayScore`, `possession`), a line score, and the sport's own:

## Baseball

*US school & pro* · source ids start `bb-` (`bb-teams`, `bb-game`…)

### Rule sets

| Rule set | Periods | Clocks offered | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| MLB — 9 innings, pitch clock | 9 innings | Pitch clock: 15 s down | [MLB: Pitch timer](https://www.mlb.com/glossary/rules/pitch-timer) |

- **MLB:** The preset is the 15 s bases-empty timer. With runners on it is 18 s, and 30 s between batters: set the timer to the one you need.

## Football (soccer)

*Football codes* · source ids start `fc-` (`fc-teams`, `fc-game`…)

### Rule sets

| Rule set | Periods | Clocks offered | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Senior (IFAB) — 2 × 45:00, clock counts up | 2 halves | Game clock: up to 45:00 | [IFAB Laws of the Game — Law 7, The Duration of the Match](https://theifab.com/laws/latest/the-duration-of-the-match) |
| Youth — 2 × 40:00, clock counts up | 2 halves | Game clock: up to 40:00 | [IFAB Laws of the Game — modifications for youth football](https://www.theifab.com/laws/latest/general-modifications) |
| High school (NFHS) — 2 × 40:00, clock counts down | 2 halves | Game clock: 40:00 down | [NFHS soccer (rules books are sold through NFHS)](https://nfhs.org/sports/soccer) |
| Futsal — 2 × 20:00, stopped clock | 2 halves | Game clock: 20:00 down | [Futsal Laws of the Game 2025/26 (U.S. Soccer)](https://ussoccer.com/stories/2025/10/futsal-lotg) |

- **Youth:** Youth half lengths are set by your league or state association; IFAB lets them be shortened. Change the game clock to match.
- **Futsal:** Futsal stops the clock whenever the ball is out of play, so the game clock is run by hand.

### Scoring

Game block buttons, one set per side: **GOAL** (+1). **−** takes one **GOAL** back.

### Teams and players

Statistics added to the [teams table](#teams): `possession` (number), `shots` (number), `shotsOnTarget` (number), `corners` (number), `fouls` (number), `offsides` (number).

Statistics added to the [players table](#players): `goals` (number), `assists` (number), `shots` (number), `yellow` (number), `red` (number), `saves` (number).

### Game table

The [shared game columns](#game) (`status`, `period`, `periodLabel`, `homeScore`, `awayScore`, `possession`) and the sport's own:

| Column | Type | Required | Example or allowed values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `addedTime` | number |  | `4` | Added time (min) |
| `homeYellow` | number |  |  | Home Yellow cards |
| `awayYellow` | number |  |  | Away Yellow cards |
| `homeRed` | number |  |  | Home Red cards |
| `awayRed` | number |  |  | Away Red cards |
| `homePens` | number |  |  | Home Shoot-out |
| `awayPens` | number |  |  | Away Shoot-out |
| `lastScorer` | string |  |  | Last scorer |

Example — a game in progress (Senior (IFAB)):

```csv
status,period,periodLabel,homeScore,awayScore,possession,addedTime,homeYellow,awayYellow,homeRed,awayRed,homePens,awayPens,lastScorer
live,2,2nd Half,2,1,,4,1,2,0,0,0,0,A. Silva
```

## Tennis

*Bat & racket* · source ids start `ten-` (`ten-teams`, `ten-game`…)

### Rule sets

| Rule set | Periods | Clocks offered | Scoring | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Best of 3 sets, tiebreak at 6–6 | 3 sets | Serve clock: 25 s down | 6-game sets, tiebreak to 7 at 6–6; first to 2 sets | [ITF Rules of Tennis 2026 (PDF)](https://www.itftennis.com/media/7221/2026-rules-of-tennis-english.pdf) |
| Best of 5 sets, 10-point tiebreak in the fifth | 5 sets | Serve clock: 25 s down | 6-game sets, tiebreak to 7 at 6–6, to 10 in the deciding set; first to 3 sets | [ITF Rules of Tennis 2026 (PDF)](https://www.itftennis.com/media/7221/2026-rules-of-tennis-english.pdf)<br>[Grand Slam Rulebook 2026 (PDF)](https://www.itftennis.com/media/5986/grand-slam-rulebook-2026-f.pdf) |

- **Best of 5 sets, 10-point tiebreak in the fifth:** The deciding set at the Grand Slams is a first-to-10 tiebreak at 6–6.

### Scoring

A **Point** button per side. Points run 0, 15, 30, 40, deuce and advantage; games, sets and tiebreaks follow the rule set.

### Teams and players

Statistics added to the [teams table](#teams): `aces` (number), `doubleFaults` (number), `firstServePct` (string), `winners` (number), `unforcedErrors` (number), `breakPoints` (string).

Statistics added to the [players table](#players): `ranking` (number), `country` (string), `plays` (string), `age` (number).

### Game table

The [shared game columns](#game) (`status`, `period`, `periodLabel`, `homeScore`, `awayScore`, `possession`), a line score, and the sport's own:

`homeScore` and `awayScore`: Worked out: sets won.

| Column | Type | Required | Example or allowed values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `home1`, `home2`, `home3` | number | | | Home games in each set — the line score |
| `away1`, `away2`, `away3` | number | | | Away games in each set — the line score |
| `homeSets` | number |  |  | Home Sets |
| `awaySets` | number |  |  | Away Sets |
| `homeGames` | number |  |  | Home Games |
| `awayGames` | number |  |  | Away Games |
| `homePoints` | number |  |  | Home Points |
| `awayPoints` | number |  |  | Away Points |
| `homePointText` | string |  | `40` | Home Point. Worked out: 0, 15, 30, 40 or AD. |
| `awayPointText` | string |  | `40` | Away Point. Worked out: 0, 15, 30, 40 or AD. |
| `serving` | string |  | `home`, `away` | Serving |
| `tiebreak` | boolean |  |  | Tiebreak |

The line score shown is for **Best of 3 sets, tiebreak at 6–6**; it has one column per period of the rule set you pick.

Example — a game in progress (Best of 3 sets, tiebreak at 6–6):

```csv
status,period,periodLabel,homeScore,awayScore,possession,home1,home2,home3,away1,away2,away3,homeSets,awaySets,homeGames,awayGames,homePoints,awayPoints,homePointText,awayPointText,serving,tiebreak
live,3,Set 3,1,1,,6,4,4,3,6,3,1,1,4,3,3,2,40,30,home,false
```
